title: Studio Retreat for 4 Near DT, Walk to Broadway!
description:
✔️ Steps to Broadway, Riverfront Park, and live music
✔️ Historic 1875 Riverfront Lofts building
✔️ Studio, 1 bathroom — sleeps up to 4
✔️ King bed with queen sleeper sofa
✔️ Kitchenette with coffee maker and mini fridge
✔️ Walk to Nashville's top attractions

The space
• Cozy hotel-style studio blending historic charm with modern comforts
• Comfortable living area with king bed, queen sleeper sofa, and smart TV
• Convenient kitchenette for coffee, snacks, and light meals
• Dedicated workspace with high-speed WiFi for work or trip planning
• Perfect for couples, friends, business travelers, and weekend getaways

🌅 Indoor & Outdoor Living
• Open-concept studio with comfortable seating
• Smart TV for streaming your favorite shows
• Dedicated workspace
• Historic building with classic character

🛏️ Bedrooms & Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 4)
• This home includes a studio layout and 1 bathroom.
• Studio — King bed; queen sleeper sofa; smart TV
• Bath — Ensuite with single vanity and walk-in glass shower

🍳 Kitchen & Dining
• Kitchenette with mini fridge/freezer
• Microwave and coffee maker
• Please note: This home does not include a full kitchen
• Salt, pepper, and cooking oil are not provided

🏖️ What's Included
• High-speed WiFi
• Smart TV
• Dedicated workspace
• We provide bedding, towels, and a small starter set of essentials

📍 Location Highlights
• Steps to Broadway honky-tonks and live music
• Walk to Riverfront Park and the Cumberland River
• Close to the Ryman Auditorium, Fifth + Broadway, and Assembly Food Hall
• Minutes to Bridgestone Arena, Ascend Amphitheater, and Downtown attractions

🚗 Parking, Safety & Notes
• Stairs: Historic 1875 building; stair access is required
• Parking: No on-site parking; paid parking available nearby at the Metropolis Parking Garages on Commerce Street. Current rates are approximately $40/day and are subject to change.
• Security cameras: Cameras are located above the front door and in the front and back sections of the entrance hallway. They monitor entry/common areas only.
• This home is not pet friendly. If there is found evidence of an animal's presence during your stay or post check-out, guests will be charged an additional cleaning fee.
• Long-term stays: Extended stays are welcome—please reach out with any questions about longer visits.
• Check in is at 4:00 PM and checkout is at 10:00 AM.
